## Highlights

- Correct Windows MSI local-group authoring so `goschedadmin` creation selects WiX's elevated local action instead of the v0.9.0 domain action.
- Strengthen Windows installer validation and lifecycle evidence for fresh install, repair, reinstall, upgrade, uninstall, and restricted daemon access.
- Prevent release preparation from pushing README edits directly to `main`, and gate every publication job on reviewed version strings.
- Restore Linux desktop packaging after upstream Wayland build requirements changed.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v0.9.1/CHANGELOG.md#091---2026-08-31) for every change.
